verdict.rationale: USCIS states up front that filing online requires creating a free online account first ("Create a free online account first to file your application"). It applies the same account-first requirement to representatives filing with Form G-28, and it publishes the G-28 delegation step. However, the evidence never spells out the credential steps (e.g., MFA or login method) or any identity-proofing steps a filer must clear, so only the account gate is disclosed in advance. Missing for 10: explicit list of credential/authentication requirements, a published identity-proofing/verification sequence before filing, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
